Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

past — the time before now. Example: I talk about the past.
experience — something that happened to you. Example: It was a wonderful experience.
memory — something you remember. Example: My best memory is my first teacher.
trip — a journey. Example: The trip was wonderful.
event — an organised occasion. Example: It is a big event.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Last year I ...
• First we ...
• Then we ...
• It was a wonderful experience.
• Thank you for listening.

Grammar focus: Past Simple (regular & irregular verbs).
Tell a story in order with the past simple: Last year I travelled to Italy. First we visited Rome, then we went to the beach. It was a wonderful experience.
